job.title: Business Development Manager - Energy Solutions
job.description:
Be the WA face of a global energy brand

Our client has global scale, a strong product range and competitive lead times. What it needs now is someone in Perth winning business. This is a new business role: you’ll be the company’s presence in WA, selling into the mining, renewables and data centre projects that are driving the state’s demand for power.

About the company

Our client is a long-established global manufacturer of electrical and power equipment with a well-resourced Australian operation. Its energy business supplies power transformers and LV/MV busway systems, with battery storage, solar and connectivity products also in the portfolio. You’ll report to the national Energy Business Unit Manager and have the authority to run your territory as your own.

What you’ll be doing

  • Finding new customers through cold calling, site visits, networking and industry events
  • Selling to EPC firms, electrical contractors and large end users in mining, renewables, data centres and commercial building services
  • Owning every deal from first enquiry to purchase order, and through delivery and after-sales
  • Putting together tenders and commercial proposals with the internal supply chain team
  • Growing the accounts you win and finding the next opportunity inside them
  • Building the brand’s profile in a market that’s still learning what it can supply
  • Travelling regularly throughout WA, including regional and remote sites, plus interstate as needed

What you’ll bring

  • 10+ years in sales or business development, with a proven record of winning new business
  • Experience selling industrial electrical products (transformers, switchgear, LV/MV distribution) is a strong advantage
  • Enough technical understanding to read a spec and put a tender together. You don’t need to be an engineer.
  • You’d rather be on site or on the phone than behind a desk
  • The self-discipline to work productively with a manager based interstate
  • Networks with WA EPCs, contractors or mining operators are a big plus

job.title: NSM - Civil and Infrastructure
job.description:
The opportunity

A well-established Australian manufacturer of infrastructure products is looking for a Head of Civil Infrastructure to lead its national sales team. You’ll own the civil portfolio, lead a team of BDMs selling direct to market across the eastern states, and set the direction for how the business wins Tier 1 & 2 projects in water, roads, subdivisions, tunnels, data centres and electrification.
This is a leadership role, not a sales role with a title. The business wants someone to take ownership, build a stronger hunting culture, and turn a healthy pipeline into consistent, profitable growth.

About the business

Our client is a respected manufacturer supplying utilities, councils, contractors and developers nationally. Its products are on major infrastructure projects across Australia, and it’s investing to grow its position in civil and emerging markets.

What you’ll be doing

  • Leading, coaching and developing a national team of BDMs, building a sharper focus on new business
  • Owning the national civil strategy, budget and forecast
  • Driving pipeline discipline: qualification, coverage and a long-range view of major projects
  • Building account strategies with Tier 1 contractors, utilities and asset owners
  • Stepping in on strategic projects at executive level
  • Working closely with manufacturing, project delivery, specification and distribution teams
  • Growing emerging segments including data centres, electrification and renewables

What we’re looking for

  • Senior sales leadership in civil infrastructure products or services (pipe, precast, drainage, geosynthetics, valves, civil materials or Tier 1 contracting)
  • A track record of leading teams and driving growth through new business, not just managing existing accounts
  • Strong commercial judgement: you understand margin, forecasting and which projects are worth chasing
  • Established relationships with Tier 1 & 2 contractors, utilities or asset owners
  • A direct, considered leadership style, and the polish to work with senior stakeholders
  • Based in Melbourne or Sydney, with interstate travel

What’s in it for you

  • A competitive base salary plus super, vehicle and STI
  • Real ownership of a national portfolio, with a GM who backs his leaders
  • Clear progression and long-term career opportunities
  • A large, growing market with major infrastructure, data centre and energy projects ahead

Next steps
Apply now with your CV, or call Olly Kemp at SearchWorks for a confidential conversation. All enquiries are treated in strict confidence.
